title: Fail closed on unreadable and non-finite API cost evidence
objective: Fail closed on unreadable and non-finite API cost evidence. Preserve existing owner semantics and historical evidence.

evidence.summary: Independent findings and corrected external-audit claims.
Read-only probes with synthetic temporary fixtures; no paid API calls.

reproduction: Run the read-only audit probe. A temporary receipt containing truncated JSON makes the lane budget guard exit 0/PASS. A current-month receipt with estimated_cost_usd=NaN makes the monthly guard exit 0/PASS and emit non-standard JSON. Use temporary fixtures, never a paid API call.

positive: Both guards retain their existing caps, reserves and valid zero-cost behavior; duplicate identical receipts count once.
Missing optional evidence, unreadable evidence and usable evidence remain distinguishable; errors include a path and reason without payload disclosure.
Valid finite nonnegative costs and aware timestamps produce deterministic accounting and standard JSON.
negative: Malformed JSON, invalid timestamps, NaN, Infinity, negative costs, booleans and conflicting duplicate costs cannot yield PASS.
Do not change caps, task budgets, reserves, billing cadence, source policy or workflow files.

forbidden_changes: restricted provider values in public artifacts
